scripts.pack: bun test && bun tsc --noEmit && bun bench.ts && bun examples.ts > examples.md && bun make-context.ts && bun build index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && bun build src/infer.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/infer.cjs && bun build index.ts --sourcemap=linked --minify --outdir=dist && bun build src/infer.ts --sourcemap=linked --minify --outdir=dist && bunx tsc index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --skipLibCheck && bun run show-size
scripts.show-size: gzip -9 -k dist/index.js && gzip -9 -k dist/infer.js && ls -lh dist/index.js.gz dist/infer.js.gz && rm dist/index.js.gz dist/infer.js.gz
